# MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into by and between
Northwind Logistics Pvt Ltd (the "Client") and Halcyon Data Systems LLC (the
"Provider").

## 1. SERVICES

1.1 Provider shall furnish the data engineering services described in each
Statement of Work executed by the parties.

1.2 Each Statement of Work shall be incorporated into this Agreement by
reference upon execution by both parties.

## 2. TERM

2.1 The term of this Agreement shall commence upon execution by both parties
and shall continue until terminated in accordance with Section 5.

2.2 The parties acknowledge that no fixed expiry applies.

## 3. FEES

3.1 Client shall pay Provider the fees set out in the applicable Statement of
Work.

3.2 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.

3.3 Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

## 4. CONFIDENTIALITY

4.1 Each party shall hold the other's Confidential Information in confidence
and shall not disclose it to any third party.

4.2 The confidentiality obligations survive termination indefinitely.

## 5. TERMINATION

5.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60)
days written notice to the other party.

5.2 Either party may terminate immediately upon a material breach that remains
uncured for thirty (30) days after written notice.

## 6. GOVERNING LAW

6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

6.2 The parties submit to binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware.

## 7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

7.1 Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages.

7.2 Provider's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid under the
applicable Statement of Work.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement by their duly
authorized representatives.

Northwind Logistics Pvt Ltd

Halcyon Data Systems LLC
